goal: Six-book pilot write-back: fold the 42 cross-source unit candidates that appear in all six books into 7 canonical knowledge units, and record how every duplicate candidate was resolved.

inputs.source_scope: six books only (Books 1-6); Books 7+ out of scope by user instruction

scope.group_rule: unit candidates recalled in all six source documents and passing cross-source alias review

method.semantic_step: Per-group cross-source re-read of the six Markdown sources; disagreements kept as explicit source-variance notes rather than resolved by preference.
method.canonical_rule: One canonical candidate per group is promoted to a knowledge unit; the remaining same-name candidates transition to rejected with a reason naming the canonical target.
method.state_chain: needs_evidence -> ready_for_review -> approved -> applied for canonical; needs_evidence -> rejected for duplicates.
method.ledger: Append-only candidate-decision-ledger.jsonl; historical R1 candidate ledgers untouched.
method.write_back: Typed exact change-set: 7 create actions, no update or delete.

semantic_change.confidence_posture: All seven units are confidence=medium, consensus=tentative, evidence_status=source_backed. No unit is marked confirmed, externally verified, or L1-L7 verified.

boundaries: No commit or push; working tree only.
No branch or extra worktree created; main is the only line.
No external verification platform used; evidence is limited to the six Markdown sources.
No visual verification of plates or objects.
primary_theme and topic_memberships left empty because Theme/Topic nodes are not materialized; recorded as research debt.
No formal relations written; cross-unit co-occurrence is noted as non-assertive prose only.
Source disagreements (authorship, dates, volumes, dimensions, toponyms) are preserved, not reconciled.
